import json

def nodes():
    return current_frame.segmentation['nodes']

def piece_info():
    out=[]
    for n in nodes():
        if n['color'] in ('N','G'):
            bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return out

def ghost_center():
    pts=[]
    for n in nodes():
        if n['color']=='g':
            for p in n['boundary']: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2, (min(cs)+max(cs))//2)

def is_gray():
    return not any(n['color']=='N' for n in nodes())

def click(r,c):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])

# Jump 1: select A at (r1,c2) center (20,30)
click(20,30)
gi = piece_info(); gc = ghost_center()
print('after sel1:', gi, 'ghost', gc)
if gc: click(*gc)
print('after jump1:', piece_info(), 'gray' if is_gray() else 'ok')
if is_gray():
    print('FAILED - need restart'); result='failed'
else:
    # Jump 2: piece now at (r1,c4) center (20,42)
    if not any(c=='G' for c,*_ in piece_info()):
        click(20,42)
    gc = ghost_center()
    print('sel2 ghost', gc)
    if gc: click(*gc)
    print('after jump2:', piece_info(), 'gray' if is_gray() else 'ok')
    if is_gray():
        print('FAILED at jump2'); result='failed2'
    else:
        # Jump 3: piece now at (r3,c4) center (32,42)
        if not any(c=='G' for c,*_ in piece_info()):
            click(32,42)
        gc = ghost_center()
        print('sel3 ghost', gc)
        if gc: click(*gc)
        print('after jump3:', piece_info(), 'gray' if is_gray() else 'ok')
        print('done flag:', last_action_result.get('done'), 'level_completed:', last_action_result.get('level_completed'), 'reward:', last_action_result.get('reward'))
